# Lab3PKG

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/kanneb/Lab3PKG/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kanneb/Lab3PKG/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

R package for Lab 3 in 732A94 Advanced R Programming at Linköping University. It implements the Euclidean algorithm and Dijkstra's algorithm, and includes the example graph `wiki_graph`.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("kanneb/Lab3PKG")
```

## Examples

```{r}
library(Lab3PKG)

euclidean(123612, 13892347912)
euclidean(100, 1000)

dijkstra(wiki_graph, 1)
dijkstra(wiki_graph, 3)
```
